_G["usMYL7A2DDjJw"]=function(i)
  local e=_G["T86FZBPQ3"][i]
  local s=""
  local j=1
  while j<=#e.b do
    local v=e.b[j]-e.k
    if v<0 then v=v+256 end
    s=s..string.char(v)
    j=j+1
  end
  local nk=((e.k*33)+17)%251+1
  local nb={string.byte(s,1,#s)}
  for j=1,#nb do nb[j]=(nb[j]+nk)%256 end
  e.k=nk; e.b=nb
  return s
end

end

    local __t=nil
    __t()
  end
end

end
